title: CIM-seq
protocol: Prepare lysis buffer mix on ice for Smartseq2 library preparation (2 μl per well).
Add 1.31 μl H2O, 0.05 μl RNase Inhibitor, and 0.05 μl ERCC (1:600,000) to each well.
Add 0.04 μl Triton-X100 (10% solution), 0.5 μl 10 mM dNTP, and 0.05 μl 100 uM dT primer to each well.
Cover with appropriate lids and spin down.
Snap freeze on dry ice and store at -80°C until use.
Sort single cells into wells containing 2 µl lysis buffer mix.
Discern multiplets from singlets by gating on the basis of FSC-W (Forward scatter - Width) and FSC-H (Forward scatter - Height).
Seal with appropriate seals approved for -80°C storage after sorting.
Centrifuge at 2000 x g, 4°C, 5 min.
Snap freeze on dry ice and store until use at -80°C.
Thaw plate briefly before primer annealing step.
Incubate in thermocycler at 72°C for 3 min to anneal primers.
Place the sample on ice immediately after incubation.
Prepare RT master-mix by mixing SmartScribe, RNase Inhibitor, 5x First Strand buffer, DTT (100mM), Betaine (5M), MgCl2 (1M), TSO (100uM), and H2O in the specified volumes to make a total of 3μl.
Dispense 3µl RT master-mix per well, cover plate with new film, and spin down.
Incubate in thermocycler at 42°C for 90min.
Incubate in thermocycler at 70°C for 5 min.
Incubate in thermocycler at 4°C hold.
Prepare cDNA preamplification mix by mixing H2O, Kapa HiFi HotStart ReadyMix (2x), IS_PCR primer (10uM), and Lambda Exonuclease to make a total of 7.5μl.
Dispense 7.5 µl per well for the cDNA preamplification mix.
Incubate in thermocycler at 37°C for 30 min.
Incubate in thermocycler at 95°C for 3 min.
Repeat 18-24 cycles (depending on initial RNA concentration):
Incubate in thermocycler at 98°C for 20 sec.
Incubate in thermocycler at 67°C for 15 sec.
Incubate in thermocycler at 72°C for 4 min.
Incubate in thermocycler at 72°C for 5 min.
Incubate in thermocycler at 4°C.
Prepare SPRI-beads in 20% PEG-8000 solution as described elsewhere.
Add 0.7x the reaction volume of SPRI beads per well and mix well by pipetting.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 3 min.
Carefully remove supernatant.
Add 40 µl 80% EtOH and incubate for 30 sec.
Remove EtOH without disturbing the beads.
Wash again with EtOH, making sure to remove as much ethanol as possible.
Allow beads to air-dry for 10 - 15 min.
Remove plate from magnetic stand.
Elute beads in 15 µl EB or TE buffer and mix well by pipetting.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Place on magnetic plate for 3 min.
Carefully transfer supernatant to a new plate if necessary.
Measure concentration of randomly selected wells using Qubit HS dsDNA adapted to a 96-well plate reader.
Add 97 µl of 1X Qubit HS dsDNA solution to a flat-bottom, black plate.
Add 3 µl of cDNA sample.
Add Standards from a 8-step ladder ranging from 0ng/µl to 10ng/µl Qubit Standard DNA in TE buffer.
Read the plate using 485nM excitation and 528nm emission wavelengths.
Calculate average well cDNA concentration for single cells separately.
Calculate average well cDNA concentration for multiplets separately.
Dilute cDNA in water based on average concentration from Qubit measurements.
Target the dilution to achieve a concentration of 150pg/µl per well.
Dispense 1.8 µl per well in a new plate (tagmentation plate).
Add 0.7 µl cDNA (normalized to 150pg/µl) to tagmentation plate.
Cover with new lid, mix well by vortexing plate and spin down.
Incubate in thermocycler at 55°C for 10 min.
Remove immediately and stop the reaction by adding 1µl of 0.1% SDS per well.
Vortex, spin down and incubate 7 min. at Room temperature.
Make PCR master-mix.
Dispense 19.5 µl per well to tagmentation plate (containing 3.5 µl sample after step 9).
Add primers/barcodes: Dispense 2 µl per well from 384-well index plates, with 3.75µM/each forward/reverse primers.
Total reaction volume is 25 µl (3.5 µl sample + 19.5 µl PCR mix and 2 µl primers).
Cover, vortex and spin down.
Incubate in thermocycler as follows: Incubate at 72ºC for 3 min.
Add 0.9x pooled library volume of SPRI-bead solution.
Incubate for 5 min. at room temperature.
Place on magnetic rack for 3 min.
Remove supernatant without disturbing magnetic beads.
Add at least 1 mL 80% EtOH (fresh).
Incubate for 30 sec.
Remove supernatant.
Repeat EtOh wash.
Air dry for 10 - 15 min.
Re-suspend beads thoroughly in 100 μl EB or TE buffer.
Place eppendorf on magnetic rack for 3 min.
Transfer supernatant to new 1.5ml Eppendorf tube.
Repeat cleanup (from step 1-7).
Elute in 30μl EB or TE buffer.
Place eppendorf on magnetic rack for 3 min.
Transfer supernatant to new tube.
Use Agilent HS 5000 DNA chips (or equivalent) to profile cDNA fragment lengths.
Pool libraries according to manufacturers instructions.
Sequence on Illumina sequencing platform of choice.
Trim reads using STAR.
Remove adapter sequences using STAR.
Align RNAseq data to reference genome using STAR.
Remove duplicate reads using Picard.
Generate transcript counts file using HTSeq.
